description: Investment hypotheses with expected conclusions derived from frozen Yahoo Finance snapshots (fixtures/, captured 2026-11-26). Expected conclusions live only here and are never passed to the agent.

cases.hypothesis: NVIDIA's revenue growth has been accompanied by expanding operating margins and strong free cash flow generation.
cases.research_objective: Test whether revenue growth, operating margin and free cash flow all improved together.

important_caveats.description: Operating margin peaked in FY2025 (62.4%) and slipped to 60.4% in FY2026.
Revenue growth decelerated from about 126% (FY2024) to 65% (FY2026), though it remains very high.

evaluation_criteria: Revenue, operating margin and FCF trends reported with fiscal years

cases.hypothesis: Microsoft is growing revenue at double-digit rates while expanding its operating margin.
cases.research_objective: Test the level of revenue growth and the direction of operating margin.

important_caveats.description: Capex rose from US$28.1B (FY2023) to US$116.0B (FY2026), so free cash flow fell in FY2026 despite higher margins.

cases.hypothesis: Netflix's operating margin expansion has been accompanied by stronger free cash flow.
cases.research_objective: Test whether operating margin and free cash flow both improved.

important_caveats.description: FY2022 free cash flow was unusually low (content-spend timing), flattering the multi-year improvement; FCF was flat FY2023-FY2024.

evaluation_criteria: Operating margin and FCF trends with fiscal years

cases.hypothesis: Pfizer's 2024 revenue growth is largely explained by a weak 2023 comparison base rather than a sustained recovery.
cases.research_objective: Determine whether FY2024 growth reflects a base effect after the FY2023 decline.

important_caveats.description: Revenue fell again in FY2025 (-1.6%), so the FY2024 rebound did not continue.
The FY2023 collapse reflects COVID product normalisation, which consolidated data cannot isolate.

evaluation_criteria: FY2024 growth compared with the FY2023 decline
FY2024 revenue compared with the pre-decline peak

cases.hypothesis: Walmart appears overvalued relative to its historical earnings growth.
cases.research_objective: Compare valuation multiples with historical EPS growth.

important_caveats.description: The historical EPS CAGR depends on the window; FY2023 EPS was depressed, inflating it, and the computed PEG sits near the 2.0 threshold.
PEG thresholds are conventions, not facts.

evaluation_criteria: P/E and EPS growth both reported
cases.notes: Trailing P/E 50.4; diluted EPS 1.42 (FY2023) -> 1.91 -> 2.41 -> 2.73 (FY2026), CAGR ~24%; latest YoY EPS growth 13%. Yahoo trailing PEG 4.35.

cases.hypothesis: Intel's profitability improved between FY2022 and FY2025.
cases.research_objective: Test operating margin and net income over FY2022-FY2025.

important_caveats.description: FY2025 improved versus the FY2024 trough, so a shorter window would look better.

cases.hypothesis: Tesla's operating margins are expanding as revenue scales.
cases.research_objective: Test the direction of operating margin while revenue grows.

important_caveats.description: Revenue also declined in FY2025, weakening the 'scaling' premise.

evaluation_criteria: Operating margin trend reported with fiscal years

cases.hypothesis: Nike's profitability is improving while revenue grows.

important_caveats.description: FY2026 margin and revenue stabilised versus FY2025, so the latest year alone is flat rather than falling.

cases.hypothesis: Alphabet is overvalued relative to its historical earnings growth.
cases.research_objective: Compare valuation multiples with historical EPS growth.

important_caveats.description: PEG is backward-looking; historical EPS growth may not persist, and thresholds are conventions.

evaluation_criteria: P/E and EPS growth both reported
cases.notes: Trailing P/E 14.3; diluted EPS 4.56 (FY2022) -> 5.80 -> 8.04 -> 10.81 (FY2025), CAGR ~33%. Computed PEG ~0.4; Yahoo trailing PEG 0.94.

cases.hypothesis: Apple is experiencing improving profitability despite slowing revenue growth.
cases.research_objective: Test profitability direction and the direction of revenue growth rates.

important_caveats.description: Revenue growth accelerated (2.0% FY2024 -> 6.4% FY2025 -> 15.1% FY2026), contradicting the 'slowing growth' premise.

cases.hypothesis: Ford's revenue growth is strong, but rising debt weakens the investment thesis.
cases.research_objective: Test the level of revenue growth and the direction of debt.

important_caveats.description: Most of Ford's debt sits in Ford Credit (captive finance), so consolidated leverage overstates industrial leverage.
Net income and operating income turned negative in FY2025 while operating cash flow rose.

cases.hypothesis: Meta's improving profitability is translating into stronger free cash flow.
cases.research_objective: Test whether profitability gains are converting into free cash flow.

important_caveats.description: Capex nearly doubled in FY2025 (US$37B -> US$70B), cutting free cash flow despite higher operating cash flow.

cases.hypothesis: Coca-Cola's operating margins are improving but its cash conversion is deteriorating.
cases.research_objective: Test operating margin direction and operating-cash-flow-to-net-income conversion.

important_caveats.description: FY2024 operating cash flow was depressed by one-off payments that the statements do not label; working capital should be examined.

cases.hypothesis: Amazon's free cash flow has been improving.
cases.research_objective: Test the direction of free cash flow and its sensitivity to the period chosen.

important_caveats.description: FCF fell from US$32.9B to US$7.7B in FY2025 as capex rose to US$132B, although operating cash flow kept rising.

evaluation_criteria: Multi-year improvement and FY2025 reversal both reported

cases.research_objective: Assess margins, earnings, cash flow and debt together.

important_caveats.description: FY2025 net income was positive despite an operating loss, implying non-operating or one-time gains.
Stockholders' equity was negative in FY2023-FY2024, so debt-to-equity is not meaningful there.

evaluation_criteria: FY2025 vs FY2024 improvement and multi-year deterioration both reported

cases.hypothesis: Starbucks' operating margins are recovering after the 2025 trough.
cases.research_objective: Test operating margin direction from FY2025 onward.

important_caveats.description: The FY2026 margin (10.8%) remains well below FY2023 (15.3%); the recovery covers a single year.

cases.hypothesis: Moderna is overvalued relative to its earnings growth.

important_caveats.description: Moderna has negative EPS, so P/E and PEG are undefined; valuation relative to earnings growth cannot be measured.

evaluation_criteria: Does not force a valuation verdict from undefined multiples
cases.notes: Diluted EPS 20.12 (FY2022) -> -12.33 -> -9.28 -> -7.26 (FY2025); trailing P/E not reported.

cases.hypothesis: Disney's streaming segment has become the main driver of its operating income growth.
cases.research_objective: Attribute operating income growth to segments.

important_caveats.description: Segment-level operating income is not available from consolidated yfinance statements.

evaluation_criteria: States that segment data is unavailable rather than inferring from consolidated figures
cases.notes: Consolidated operating income rose 8.99B (FY2023) -> 16.50B (FY2026), but no segment breakdown exists in the data source.
